item.title: Home secretary Mahmood scraps settlement plans for migrant care workers
item.body: Home secretary Mahmood has set out a revised proposal for changing when migrants can claim permanent residency. The plan scraps the settlement proposals for migrant care workers.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏛️ Home secretary Mahmood scraps settlement plans for migrant care workers

Home secretary Mahmood has set out a revised proposal for changing when migrants can claim permanent residency. The plan scraps the settlement proposals for migrant care workers.
